hero.title: Your journey toward transformation starts today.
hero.sub: We design tailor-made technology solutions for African industry

values.innovate: We imagine solutions tailored to your needs
values.paragraph: A subsidiary of the NICOMATIC Group, present in around twenty countries worldwide, we design custom industrial machines, support businesses, and develop innovative technology solutions to optimize processes and meet operational challenges. Our mission is to transform local industry through the synergy of our expertise in electronics, mechanics, and software. Discover how we propel your projects toward excellence.

metadata.title: About | Nicomatic Senegal
metadata.description: Discover Nicomatic Senegal’s story, from exploration to impact.

1976.title: The birth
1976.description: Paul Nicollin opens Nicomatic in Bons-en-Chablais, France. Nicomatic is founded

2022.title: The spark
2022.description: It all starts with a bold vision: bridging the gap between industry and innovation in Africa. In 2022, we lay our first stones in Senegal, exploring strategic partnerships with leading engineering schools such as École Polytechnique de Dakar. Far from a simple transfer of skills, we are building an ecosystem where engineering and creativity intertwine to shape the future of local industry.

2024.title: The transformation
2024.description: 2024 marks a turning point. G-NI’s Factory officially becomes Nicomatic Sénégal, a subsidiary of the Nicomatic group. A giant leap that positions us as a key player in Senegalese industry, with a broader scope: industrial machine design, IT consulting, strategic and technical support for startups, and a talent accelerator. The goal? Shake up standards, create tailor-made solutions and boost the competitiveness of local industries.

impact.title: Impact
impact.text: Thanks to our cross-disciplinary approach combining mechanical engineering, electronics and IT, we are pushing the limits of local production. Every project is a challenge, every challenge is an opportunity. African industry is on the move, and our ambition is to become its catalyst for industrial innovation.

trust.title: Trust
trust.lead: African industry is built on trust in our talent and resources.
trust.text: We believe in the potential of African industry and in those who drive it forward. By valuing local skills and developing tailored solutions, we are building an ecosystem where trust is the engine of every success.

interconnection.title: Interconnection
interconnection.lead: A strong network of exchanges strengthens African industry.
interconnection.text: Africa’s industrial future rests on strong connections. By fostering collaboration between engineers, companies and markets, we are creating a dynamic network where the exchange of knowledge and technology accelerates the transformation of the sector.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.lead: Innovating means propelling Africa toward a sustainable industrial future.
innovation.text: Innovation is at the heart of our approach. By integrating technological advances into the realities of African industry, we design bold solutions that redefine production standards and open up new perspectives.
